title: Preparation batches
purpose: Find independent preparation batches, their labelled aliquots, actual preparation events and QC findings before analytical work.
summary: Find preparation batches: the labelled aliquots prepared from samples before analysis, their actual start and completion, and any open QC findings.

tasks.title: Find a preparation batch
steps: Type a method code, aliquot label, sample ID or P-number in [[Search]], then select [[Apply]].
Select the batch number to open it.

tasks.title: Find aliquots not yet used in analysis
steps: Open [[More filters]], set [[Attention]] to Aliquots not yet used, then select [[Apply]].

tasks.title: Start a preparation batch
steps: Select [[New preparation batch]]. Only analysts and admins can create one.

good_to_know: Closing membership and completing preparation are separate. Neither fills in the other.
Counts include cancelled aliquots, because the work was still performed.
Zero open QC findings does not mean the analytical results are approved.

sections.title: Access and navigation
paragraphs: Active internal staff with a laboratory role can read this workspace. Analysts can create and change preparation work. An admin has operational analyst access; a client account or superuser status alone does not grant it.

items.label: New preparation batch
items.description: Analysts create a batch for an active preparation method. A batch number opens its preparation record; analytical batches are excluded from this list.

sections.title: Search and filters
paragraphs: Apply searches and filters across all records, returning to page 1. More filters opens additional filters; active filter chips remove one filter, and Clear all resets the query. Invalid filters show errors and no records. Rows per page offers 25, 50 or 100, initially 25; other page sizes are refused. First, Previous, Next and Last keep the query. Sortable headings reverse their sort. Columns changes local column visibility/order, with reset and keyboard controls; it does not change which records qualify.
The initial order is newest created first. Batch, Aliquots, Prep started and Created support ascending or descending sorting. Counts include historical membership, including cancelled aliquots.

items.label: Search
items.description: Case-insensitive matches on preparation method code, aliquot label, laboratory sample ID and client sample ID. A complete P-number such as P-00012 matches that batch number. Method version, notes and creator are not searched.

items.label: Method
items.description: Optional exact preparation method/version; choices are active methods with at least one active preparation requirement, ordered by code and version.

items.label: Matrix
items.description: Any matrix, Water, Wastewater or Soil.

items.label: Status
items.description: Any status, Open membership, Closed membership or Preparation completed. Completed checks the actual completion timestamp independently of membership; open and closed check membership independently of completion.

items.label: Attention
items.description: Under More filters: Any attention, Aliquots not yet used, or Open QC findings. Unused means an uncancelled aliquot has no result revision using it. QC findings uses the same current blocking evaluator as the detail page.

items.label: Prep start from / Prep start to
items.description: Optional inclusive dates of actual start in laboratory local time; the end cannot precede the start. A start date restriction excludes batches with no start recorded.

items.label: Batch
items.description: Stable P-number opening the preparation batch.

items.label: Status
items.description: Preparation completed takes precedence when a completion exists; otherwise Open membership or Closed membership.

items.label: Preparation method / Matrix
items.description: The exact method version and sample matrix shared by the batch.

items.label: Aliquots
items.description: Number of distinct labelled physical aliquots, including cancelled ones.

items.label: Tests covered
items.description: Distinct requested tests linked through aliquots; a test covered by several aliquots counts once.

items.label: Used in analysis
items.description: Distinct analytical batches having any result revision linked to an aliquot; otherwise Not used.

items.label: Open QC findings
items.description: Number of current blocking preparation findings. Zero does not itself mean analytical results are approved.

items.label: Prep started / Prep completed
items.description: Actual event times, or Not recorded. Membership closure never fills these times.

items.label: Created by / Equipment / Created / Notes
items.description: Optional columns hidden initially: batch creator, primary equipment or Not recorded, creation time and notes. Equipment is informational and does not decide approval.

sections.title: Empty states
paragraphs: No preparation batches yet offers creation to analysts. No preparation batches match these filters offers clearing the filters. Review configured preparation requirements if the new-batch method choices are empty.
